note: Durations and byte sizes are MEASURED from the downloaded audio with ffprobe -- none are estimated. Titles are derived from the Drive filenames (the ID3 tags carry only a Suno "made with suno" comment, no usable title on 173 of 176 files); `created` and `sunoId` ARE read from that ID3 comment. Shelf assignment is inferred from title keywords -- it is the one editorial layer here. `main`/`sub` are NOT stored here: the split of a title into its main line and its mix/version tail is derived by scripts/build-music.py so that rule lives in exactly one place.
